simple.meaning: קוֹמְמִיּוּת (qôwmᵉmîyûwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “elevation , i.e. (adverbially) erectly (figuratively).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קוֹמְמִיּוּת (H6968) before moving outward to related references.

definitions.full: H6968. qomemiyyuth קוֺמְמִיּוּת noun feminine uprightness ; — only as adverb Lev 26:13 made you go upright , i.e. as freemen. אַלְקוּם see above p.39.

occurrences.englishText: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.
